lead_independence.headline: Fort Pierce approves $10.1M Axon contract for AI body cameras and Tasers
lead_independence.lead: The Fort Pierce city commission unanimously approved a 10-year, $10,139,037.87 contract with Axon Enterprise, Inc. to provide body cameras, artificial intelligence technology tools, and Tasers for the police department. Commissioners voted 5-0 during a meeting on Monday, Sept. 14, to replace aging equipment with what Fort Pierce Police Department Chief David M. Smith called the company's top tier offering.
